value.rationale: The natural structural question asks how likely independently selected idempotents generate a finite incidence algebra. The answer gives all tuple-length probabilities for stars, a universal height-two weighted formula, and a non-obvious q=2 versus q>=3 switch in dominant failure mechanism. This adds exact probabilistic information not supplied by known minimum-generator thresholds.
